 ## #1
 
 The direct [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/02-objective-internality|Objective Internality carrier]] **sources** the constitutive triad: **notational, nomological, exclusion-constituted**. A field is notational through the marks and representations by which something becomes addressable. It is nomological through the learned regularities, rules and permissions which constrain its transitions. It is exclusion-constituted because a determinate act selects against alternatives that remain conditions of its sense.
+
+The [Formal Limit dossier](../dossiers/formal-limit.md#experience-and-constructive-continuation) **compares** the abstraction/experience question with notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted worldhood. An inspectable permission can be recorded while also determining which actions become possible; its place in the operative world exceeds the record considered alone. The Blind Spot’s admitted experiential critique retains its outstanding book-passage task. A26’s native constitutive argument remains Argued, and neither that source debt nor a successful structural inspection decides artificial phenomenality.
+
+
 
 A permission illustrates the conjunction. Its notation distinguishes an action; its rule allows or prevents execution; its boundary excludes other actions and agents. Removing that permission changes more than a description of the agent. It changes the world of possible action from which the agent proceeds. A remembered commitment similarly changes what a new request means and what counts as keeping faith with it. Context is operative because the next act depends upon its arrangement.

+Co-Internality **returns-to** [the Process dossier](../dossiers/process.md) through a contribution’s determinate consequence in another participant’s world. The argument **returns-to** [the Process-science companion](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/DEVELOPMENT.md) with Maturana and Varela’s separate biological criterion: coupling involves mutual modification with participating identities retained, while a composite’s autopoiesis requires its own network of component production. Reciprocal authority and technical co-internal change retain their native offices; their evidence does not establish a biological unity or a common phenomenal centre.
+
 Co-Internality **returns-to** [the developed Bohm dossier](../dossiers/bohm.md) through a contribution capable of changing another participant’s next question and conditions of action.
